headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2023, back when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW TNT Title as Samoa Joe vs. Darby Allin battled it out in a No Holds Barred match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.84 ? a stone-cold classic ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Joe avenged his earlier loss in a No Holds Barred rematch, taking the TNT Championship back from Allin just four days before facing him again in that same city.
Looking back to 2025, when FTR vs. Moxley & Yuta settled things in a Mid-South Street Fight match, headlining the show on Collision, rated 7.38 ? a well-worked match in a physical tag team battle.

Turning the clock back to 2023: it was Timothy Thatcher's first night in AEW against Bryan Danielson, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.41 ? a well-worked match. Making his AEW debut at Bryan Danielson's personal request, the veteran grappler flew in from Tokyo for a single day just to test himself against the American Dragon.
